basic_info.description: Rare offering located in coveted Eureka Valley! This very unique, stylish, and terraced mid-century design 4-unit income property offers great income as a prime investment or owner-user opportunity, with the possibility of adding ADUs! The property features four bright, spacious, unique 1 bedroom flats, separate offices, with separate exterior entrances, expansive decks, landscaping & 4 garage spaces, all on an oversized lot 6128 sqft. Each unit features panoramic breathtaking views from the SF skyline, private outdoor areas & yards, perfect for relaxing, entertaining & work from home! All units are separately metered for electricity & gas, one unit features in-unit washer/dryer, the building has shared professionally managed laundry room. Fantastic Eureka Valley location with close proximity to restaurants, shopping & public transportation. An excellent 83 WalkScore, blocks to famed 24th Street with endless restaurant & shopping options, Whole Foods, Philz Coffee & much more! Near the Castro, Noe Valley and Dolores Heights, close to Kite Hill, Seward Mini Park & Noe Valley Tennis Courts! Easy access to Downtown SF, Silicon Valley tech centers, SFO, US 101, I-280. This property truly has everything owners & renters want in a prime location - a must see!
